name: bracket-chord-switches-tab
description:
The hotkeys store binds nextTab to cmd+shift+] and pressing it moved no tab, while cmd+k on the same action worked. Cause: AppKit's charactersIgnoringModifiers ignores command and option but NOT shift, so the event arrives carrying '}' while the stored combo spells ']', and the matcher compared the two directly. Letters were never affected because the match lowercases first.

Both rows are LOCAL urls. A scenario must not gate on a page the VM cannot load - it has DNS but no outbound HTTPS - and the row this chord reaches is proven by the line the cold-row path logs rather than by a navigation committing.

actions.note: let the window finish first paint and the sidebar announce itself
ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot
nextTab. The keycode for ] is 30, already in keycombo.sh.
the row opens and the page starts loading
the second row's own page, read from the page itself rather than the run log

assertions.label: the-chord-reached-the-next-row
assertions.desc: THE assertion. The second row's page loads only if the chord moved the tab - its control scenario asserts the same page never opens with the chord removed, which is what makes this evidence about the key rather than about startup opening both rows.

assertions.label: still-one-window
assertions.desc: Liveness, and a guard against the chord reaching something that opens a window.
